requirement.statement: AI runtime observability SHALL retain bounded structured provider, tool and domain-transition metrics by default, while raw streamed reasoning content SHALL require an explicit debug retention policy with capacity and lifetime limits.

case.given: An AI actor completes provider and tool turns
case.then: The sink SHALL retain actor/turn/provider identities, first-token time, generation time, token counts, tool duration and structured receipt references

case.given: A provider streams think or reasoning deltas
case.when: debug retention is not explicitly enabled
case.then: The sink MUST NOT persist every raw reasoning delta into long-lived session artifacts

case.given: Debug reasoning retention is explicitly enabled
case.then: The policy SHALL enforce declared capacity and lifetime bounds and SHALL not change Conversation or provider-context authority
